mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen in each of the last three weekly readings (-30.4 to -24.1), and this monotone recovery persists one more month because the same reopening momentum that lifted the prior four weeks continues to release deferred in-person shopping demand.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly means -30.4, -29.1, -25.0, -24.1 over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is at or below the last-28-day mean of -27.15, i.e. the prior three-week upward slope does not extend.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM rose from 0.0 to +8.6 over three weeks, showing households re-adopting routine out-of-home errand trips; the same routine-restoration impulse carries into discretionary retail browsing, lifting RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses above +5 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved 0.0 -> 0.4 -> 7.1 -> 8.6 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM stays above +5 for the next two weeks while RETAIL_REC falls or stays flat, breaking the cross-category routine-restoration link.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES fell 4.2 points in the latest week (-24.4 to -28.6) after rising for two weeks, signalling a fresh shift back to home-based work; lost weekday commuter and office-adjacent footfall depresses RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 3 points week-on-week, as from -24.4 at t-1w to -28.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the week following the WORKPLACES drop is equal to or higher than the t-0w reading of -24.1.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of recovering TRANSIT (-24.4 to -19.0) alongside a flattening, no-longer-rising RESIDENTIAL (9.7 to 8.6) means people are substituting out-of-home trips for staying home; the released trip budget flows into retail venues and lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT above -20 while RESIDENTIAL is below +9 in the same weekly reading
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 5.4 points while RESIDENTIAL eased 1.1 points between t-3w and t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT is above -20 and RESIDENTIAL below +9, mean RETAIL_REC over the following 28 days is not higher than the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS remains deeply suppressed at -33.1 despite partial recovery, indicating leisure mobility is still constrained by caution; constrained leisure trips cap overall discretionary outing frequency and keep RETAIL_REC from exceeding its recent ceiling over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -30 percent change from baseline for a second consecutive week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS bottomed at -41.4 and is still -33.1 at t-0w, never above -30
failure_condition: PARKS stays below -30 while mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days rises above the last-14-day mean of -24.55.

mechanism_narrative: The one-week TRANSIT relapse (-17.6 to -19.0) after a two-week climb is the signature of a newly re-tightened mobility rule; transit-riding consumers cut discretionary destination trips first, so RETAIL_REC declines within one week of the transit reversal.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT turns negative week-on-week after two or more consecutive weekly increases, as at t-0w
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT -24.4 -> -22.4 -> -17.6 -> -19.0 and WORKPLACES -32.7 -> -26.4 -> -24.4 -> -28.6 both reversed in the final week
failure_condition: In the week after a TRANSIT reversal, RETAIL_REC is equal to or above the pre-reversal level of -25.0.

mechanism_narrative: Late-August through mid-September is the Hong Kong back-to-school and pre-autumn restocking window; the simultaneous rise in GROCERY_PHARM (0.0 to +8.6) and four-week RETAIL_REC recovery reflect seasonal household purchasing, which peaks in the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:decision point 2021-08-15 falls inside the back-to-school/pre-autumn seasonal window
regime_hint: seasonal transition from late summer to early autumn
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the 28 days to mid-September is lower than the last-28-day mean of -27.15 despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above +5.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL sits at or above +8.5 while WORKPLACES drops at least 4 points week-on-week, households are actively re-substituting home time for out-of-home time; that stay-home substitution drains retail trip frequency and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL >= +8.5 and WORKPLACES week-on-week change <= -4 points in the same reading
evidence_refs: fact:at t-0w RESIDENTIAL = 8.6 and WORKPLACES fell 4.2 points to -28.6
regime_hint: stay-at-home substitution regime with residential mobility pinned near +9
failure_condition: While RESIDENTIAL >= +8.5 and WORKPLACES falls at least 4 points week-on-week, mean RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is at or above the prior 14-day mean.
